summary: Northbridge Bank security review: request for retention controls details + baseline compliance reporting pack (audit logs, retention export, RBAC, residency)
environment: prod (Hosted today; evaluating Dedicated + Private) / regions: us-east, eu-west
body:
Issue summary
Northbridge Bank (InfoSec + Procurement) is conducting a security review tied to an enterprise expansion (Dedicated capacity in us-east + potential Private deployment later this year). They are requesting (a) written retention controls details per data class with purge semantics and (b) a customer-ready “baseline compliance reporting pack” they can attach to their SOC 2/ISO-style evidence portal.

Impact
Procurement blocker for contract execution. Customer is holding signature until they receive acceptable evidence for retention + audit logging, and a timeline for report pack delivery.

Customer ask (from SE call + follow-up email)
1) Retention controls
- Supported data classes and default retention by tier (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
- How retention is enforced (TTL vs purge jobs), purge frequency, and verification/monitoring
- Whether prompts/completions are stored, and if so how to disable and/or reduce retention
- Legal hold / incident hold: how it works, who can approve, and whether holds are auditable
- Ability to export retention configuration and change history

2) Compliance reporting pack (baseline)
They want a downloadable package (PDF preferred, JSON/CSV acceptable for evidence) including:
- Audit log coverage summary (event types, actor fields, time window)
- Audit log export for a specified time window (last 90 days)
- Retention configuration export (current policy + defaults) and confirmation of enforcement
- Data residency / region summary (where their data is processed/stored)
- Access control / RBAC report (roles, admins, SSO status, key settings)
- Evidence checklist / mapping to common control language (SOC 2 / ISO 27001)

Requested timelines (customer)
- Initial written answers + current state documentation by Feb 12, 2025
- A sample compliance report pack by Feb 28, 2025
- Final customer-ready baseline package by Mar 15, 2025 (or written committed plan with dates)

What we can provide now (internal initial assessment)
- Retention controls overview doc + FAQ language (customer-ready with minor edits)
- Current audit log export (time-windowed) via audit-log-exporter and templates
- Draft outline of compliance report pack (baseline) and evidence checklist
- Written statement on where prompts/completions are stored (and when disabled), plus current defaults by product tier

Open questions / gaps
- Final “baseline compliance reporting pack” generator service is still MVP; may require manual assembly for this customer’s first delivery.
- Need to confirm exact retention defaults for Dedicated (and whether customer-specific overrides are GA vs design-partner).
- Confirm legal hold workflow wording (avoid over-committing: legal hold supported for audit logs + compliance evidence artifacts; request/response logs depend on logging configuration).

Owner / next steps
- SE/Sales enablement coordination: Markus Klein to drive customer comms and collect exact evidence portal requirements.
- GRC: Olga Petrov to finalize customer-facing checklist and ensure control language is acceptable.
- Eng (audit export + retention): Kevin Osei to confirm exporter capabilities and retention config export endpoint status.
- PM Security & Compliance: Naomi Feldman to confirm committed timeline and what is manual vs productized for March delivery.

Acceptance criteria for this ticket
- Customer receives a consolidated response package (docs + exports) and acknowledges receipt
- Clear committed dates for the baseline compliance pack delivery (even if manual v1)
- Follow-up tasks filed for any missing audit event types / exporter gaps surfaced by customer

Attachments/links
- Customer email thread: 20250207-northbridge-bank-security-review-followups (Gmail)
- Call notes: 2025-02-06 security review (Fireflies)

Comments / activity log
2025-02-07 (Rachel Kim, CS) — Ticket created after SE escalated procurement blocker. Added initial list of asks and requested timeline.

2025-02-07 (Markus Klein, Assignee) — Reached out to Northbridge Bank to confirm evidence format and whether they need a signed attestation letter vs report exports. Requested exact audit window and list of required event types.

2025-02-10 (Olga Petrov, GRC) — Drafted customer-facing evidence checklist (SOC 2-style). Flag: do not claim “immutable audit logs” unless we qualify storage/controls. Suggested phrasing: “append-only semantics at application layer + restricted deletion by retention jobs; deletions are tracked.”

2025-02-11 (Kevin Osei, Eng) — Confirmed audit-log-exporter supports time-windowed export + filters in latest build; bundling retention config export is behind feature flag (target enablement for design partners). Proposed workaround: run retention export endpoint separately and attach to package.

2025-02-12 (Markus Klein) — Sent Northbridge a written response covering (1) supported data classes, (2) current defaults by tier, (3) how to disable request/response logging, (4) audit log export sample (CSV), and (5) draft evidence checklist. Asked for confirmation if PDF is mandatory; offered PDF “cover letter” + JSON/CSV artifacts as v1.

2025-02-14 (Customer, via email relayed by Markus) — Confirmed PDF is preferred but not mandatory; they can accept a zipped package with a human-readable summary + CSV/JSON evidence. Requested explicit statement: purge cadence and verification metrics exist; asked for clarity on traces/metrics retention and whether tenant-specific overrides are supported.

2025-02-17 (Sean Gallagher, SRE) — Added internal note: do not promise real-time purge. Retention is enforced by scheduled jobs; typical lag is <24h but can extend during maintenance. Suggested customer-safe language + include “verification dashboard exists internally; can share screenshots if needed.”

2025-02-18 (Naomi Feldman, PM) — Confirmed baseline compliance pack MVP can be delivered manually for first 1–2 customers by end of Feb; productized generator targeted for mid-March GA criteria. Requested that CS/SE set expectation: “baseline pack delivered by Mar 15; earlier sample by Feb 28.”

2025-02-20 (Dr. Aisha Rahman, Security) — Approved sharing retention controls overview + audit log template, with edits: define data classes precisely (audit logs vs request logs) and clarify legal hold approval matrix and audit trail.

2025-02-21 (Markus Klein) — Prepared “Northbridge baseline compliance pack (draft)” contents list:
- Readme/cover letter (PDF)
- Retention configuration export (JSON)
- Audit log export (CSV) for Nov 21–Feb 21, filtered to admin + security events
- Audit log coverage summary (PDF)
- Data residency summary (PDF)
- RBAC / access controls snapshot (PDF)
- Evidence checklist (CSV)
Pending: customer confirmation of exact event types and whether they need additional console screenshots.

Current status
Waiting on customer to confirm:
- Required audit event types and actor identifiers
- Exact time window for audit export
- Whether they require a signed statement or only artifacts

Support notes (internal)
- If customer asks about missing event types, reference SUP-3917 and exporter roadmap.
- If customer asks about retention enforcement lag, reference known behavior and remediation runbook; avoid promising strict per-hour purge guarantees.
- If customer needs dashboard access, coordinate via internal helpdesk (INT-611) for Security/GRC only; do not grant customer direct access.

Next update due
By 2025-02-24: deliver sample zipped package and request customer acceptance; confirm Mar 15 final delivery date and whether any contractual language is required.
security_notes: Customer-facing content must avoid over-commitments on purge SLA. Legal hold must be described as an approved exception workflow with auditable trail; do not imply customer self-serve legal hold unless explicitly GA. Do not disclose internal dashboard URLs; screenshots can be shared upon Security approval.
external_customer_contact: Northbridge Bank — Security Review team (via Markus Klein / Sales Engineering)
request_channel: Sales Engineering escalation + customer email follow-up
resolution_summary: Pending customer confirmation. Draft artifacts prepared; plan is to deliver sample package by Feb 28 and finalize baseline compliance report pack by Mar 15 (manual assembly if needed).
